notes: One major-slot unique (weapon, chest, helm, or shield). Heart-Cinder unlocks the slot per character. Sleep is free at the cap, leaves a permanent remnant, and does not stack the same unique. Wake-Oil reawakens one item and turns its remnant off. Consume +20 is about 1.4x to 1.6x on that unique (package 0.50). Remnants are 12% of the unconsumed unique lines, never the full mechanic. Dormant set bonuses are 25% of awakened.
hint: A unique can be consumed once this hero has Heart-Cinder and the consume-slot recipe.

wake_oil.name: Wake-Oil
wake_oil.flavor: A rare craft drop. Awakens one dormant unique and keeps its consume progress.

heart_cinder.name: Heart-Cinder
heart_cinder.flavor: Character-bound. Opens the consume slot. May be given to a higher-level crafter as a mat, not traded as goods.

mimic_heart.name: Mimic Heart
mimic_heart.flavor: Still beating. Opens the last two awaken stages.

awakenNote: v84q: the Consume slot is folded into Awaken (data/power.json awaken). Remnants and the materials stay.
